changelog: Themes: 26 of them (Amber Night, Discord, Nord, Dracula, Solarized, Midnight OLED, Sakura, Mint and more), eight of them light, each one applied in a tap
Settings → Appearance → Accent & background is a real editor: a colour picker with a saturation square, a hue strip and a hex field for the accent, the background and a second colour of your own
Fine tuning: any single surface (cards, chips, borders, secondary text, code blocks) can be set by hand, with a plain warning when the contrast drops below what text needs
The agents can style the app too: a new theme_mcp lets a model list, apply or build a theme and read back the readability of what it made
Every chat now starts in its own workspace under /root/chats/<id>, so one conversation's scratch files no longer land in the next one's
Hermes gains a plugin and skill marketplace: browse, install and remove plugins from Settings → Hermes → Plugins
Secondary text on a light background went from 2.1:1 to a readable 4.5:1 across all the light themes
